body:
**Syncom Formulations (SYNCOMF): 40/100, AVOID for now**
- The numbers fit the pattern well:
  - Six-quarter OPM climb, 12% to 22%.
  - Debt down from 83 to about 0.
  - FII 0.35% to 2.23%.
  - Recomputed P/E 21.7x.
- But no operational cause could be found. There is no new plant. The only cited 2026 capital spend is a ₹57 cr purchase of commercial property in Andheri, a capital-allocation flag.
- Other income is about 27% of PBT. The base is about 4.2 lakh retail holders on a ₹22 stock, and the CFO changed in August 2026.
- Per the skill rule, a margin jump with no identifiable cause is a reason to downgrade.

body:
- **FPI outflows:**
  - FPIs pulled about ₹2.45 lakh crore out of Indian equities by the third week of Sept 2026, against a record ₹1.66 lakh crore in 2025. PL Capital puts 2025 at about ₹1.7 lakh crore.
  - Sources: [Ziromarket](https://www.ziromarket.com/blog/fpi-outflows-india-2026-record); [PL India](https://www.plindia.com/news/foreign-funds-flee-fii-outflows-in-five-months-of-2026-already-exceed-full-year-2025-total/)
- **SEBI bulletin (Apr 2026):**
  - FPIs were net sellers of ₹1,25,736 crore across asset classes in FY26, with the steepest monthly sell-off in March 2026.
  - Cumulative net DII inflow was a record ₹8.5 lakh crore in FY26, tied to record SIP flows.
  - Source: [SEBI Bulletin](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/apr-2026/1777539656528.pdf)
- **DII offset in 2026:** DIIs bought ₹4.16 lakh crore in 2026 against ₹2.7 lakh crore of FII selling. — [Kalkine](https://www.kalkine.co.in/article/investment/domestic-institutions-offset-rs-27-lakh-crore-of-fii-selling-as-sip-inflows-stay-robust-in-2026)
- **SIP figures:**
  - Ziromarket reports ₹32,297 crore in Aug 2026.
  - Kalkine reports ₹32,087 crore in Mar 2026 and ₹31,115 crore in Apr 2026.
  - Monumoney cites ₹26,632 crore, which conflicts. Verify against AMFI.
  - Sources: [Ziromarket](https://www.ziromarket.com/blog/fpi-outflows-india-2026-record); [Kalkine](https://www.kalkine.co.in/article/investment/domestic-institutions-offset-rs-27-lakh-crore-of-fii-selling-as-sip-inflows-stay-robust-in-2026); [Monumoney](https://monumoney.in/blog/sip-record-26632-cr-fpi-outflow-2026-exit-liquidity)
- **MSCI weight:** India's MSCI EM weight fell from about 20% (Sep 2024) to 11.94% (30 Apr 2026). Passive funds must follow. — [Finnovate](https://www.finnovate.in/learn/blog/msci-em-india-weight-fpi-flows-taiwan-korea); [Multibagg](https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/india-fii-flows-em-valuation-cmqbsct4l01rks60joxx6bf8i)
- **Valuation premium:** India's forward P/E premium over MSCI EM was cited at about 77% at the peak. Other sources say the premium compressed to about a two-decade low by 2026, so sources conflict on timing. — [Multibagg](https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/fii-selling-india-2026-outflows-cmpk1hw2fp4cgr20jzh8nlp03); [Investace](https://investacecapital.com/research/fii/)
- **Sector selling:** BFSI led FPI selling, with about $18bn out in 45 days around Mar–Apr 2026. In May 2026 the outflow was $3.44bn. — [Finnovate Apr](https://www.finnovate.in/learn/blog/fpi-selling-india-half-april-2026-bfsi-sectoral-flows); [Finnovate May](https://www.finnovate.in/learn/blog/fpi-flows-may-2026-india-sectoral-analysis)
- **Partial reversal:** FPIs added ₹23,544 crore in Aug 2026, attributed to earnings and rupee stability. — [Multibagg](https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/fii-fpi-india-2026-flows-cmoihcj2us18tp30j229mjvsc)
- **Earnings and the rupee:** Nifty quarterly profit growth was cited at 12.9% and the forward P/E at about 17.6. The rupee was near 96.78 per USD in Oct 2026. — [Multibagg](https://www.multibagg.ai/market-pulse/articles/india-fii-flows-em-valuation-cmqbsct4l01rks60joxx6bf8i); [Dezerv](https://www.dezerv.in/blog/indian-equities-in-2026-is-the-earnings-cycle-turning/)
